name: Xin Hee Co., Ltd.
summary: Xin Hee Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the manufacturing and finishing of knitted clothing and other fabric-based apparel. Their extensive product portfolio stretches beyond garments to encompass a wide variety of items such as footwear, headwear, gloves, bags, fur and leather goods, jewelry, eyewear, office requisites, and timepieces. Additionally, the company actively participates in international trade, handling the import and export of decorative ornaments and fragrances. Established in 2006, Xin Hee operates from its headquarters in Xiamen, China.
